name: Taiwan Line Tek Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Line Tek Electronic Co., Ltd., established in 1967 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a global provider of electronic connectivity solutions, serving markets across Asia, Europe, and America. The company's primary business revolves around the manufacturing, processing, and commercialization of electronic wiring harnesses, signal transmission cables, and power supply cords. It specializes in producing various power transmission lines for computer systems and electrical appliances. Furthermore, Taiwan Line Tek handles the trade and processing of power cord sets, signal connection cables for information peripheral devices, and high-performance interconnectivity solutions for communication systems. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes AC power cords, which are utilized in a wide array of applications such as computers, telecommunications equipment, consumer electronics, power tools, lighting fixtures, and medical devices. The company also offers DC cables, notably signal connection cables for computers and their peripherals, alongside critical accessories for telecommunication transmission. Complementing these are electronic ballasts, electronic switch controllers, and a diverse range of fiber optic passive components. These fiber optic solutions are designed for extensive applications, including audio systems, CD-ROM drives, mobile phone charging, cell phones, digital camcorders, digital cameras, DVDs, gaming consoles, headphones, joysticks, keyboards, LCD monitors, mice, MP3 players, network devices, notebooks, PDAs, printers, projectors, speakers, telephones, televisions, and VCRs.
